verdict.rationale: cubic's agent can generate fixes for issues flagged in its own code review and push commits to the PR branch ("Fix with cubic", one-click targeted fixes). That loosely covers fixing code-quality or lint-style findings, but only within the review-finding workflow. missing for 10: evidence of writing tests, explicit lint-error fixing, resolving merge conflicts, updating dependencies, and independent or hands-on corroboration of fix quality.
